name: Morón AB
description: Morón AB hosts the 496th Air Base Squadron and provides strategic airfield and logistics support for U.S. and allied operations in southern Europe.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate
gates.notes: Primary entry point. Visitor processing and Pass & ID located nearby. Taxis drop off/pick up only at gate.
gates.address: Main Gate, Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: El Comedor Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC serving breakfast, lunch, dinner, midnight meal, grab-n-go, and flight/ground meals with 2-hour notice.
resources.hours: Breakfast 0600-0900; Lunch 1100-1400; Dinner 1600-1900; Midnight Meal 0015-0145; Grab-n-Go 24/7 daily
resources.address: Bldg 115, Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: NEXmart
resources.description: Basic exchange mart offering snacks, convenience items, and limited retail. Check cashing and money exchange available.
resources.hours: See posted hours; support fluctuates with Spanish holidays
resources.address: Bldg 107, Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: Medical Aid Station
resources.description: Limited medical support for military members only via two Independent Duty Medical Technicians (IDMTs). Liaison for appointments at NS Rota Clinic or TRICARE International SOS.
resources.hours: Duty hours for routine; emergencies coordinated 24/7 via liaison
resources.address: Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: Fitness & Sports Center
resources.description: Full gym with cardio theater, saunas, racquetball court, free weights, ellipticals, volleyball, basketball, softball field, tennis courts, and outdoor courts. Offers incentive programs and group fitness classes (cycling, total body reset, glutes/abs/legs).
resources.hours: See FSS site or posted schedule for current hours; facility supports 24/7 access where posted
resources.address: Bldg 312, Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: USAF Finance Office
resources.description: Military pay, vouchers, and finance services. One-person office supporting Team Morón.
resources.address: Bldg 106 (North entrance), Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: ATM - Bldg 106
resources.description: 24/7 ATM for euro withdrawals (CIRRUS and major credit cards). Linked to various accounts.
resources.address: Bldg 106 North entrance, Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: BBVA Bank ATM
resources.description: 24/7 ATM located at BBVA bank branch. Euro transactions only.
resources.address: Bldg 541 (North corner, between Gas Station and School), Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: Banco de Santander / Spanish Bank
resources.description: Spanish bank branch on base with fluctuating hours based on Spanish holidays and schedules.
resources.address: Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: Housing / Pass & ID / Finance Office
resources.description: Combined office for on-base housing assignments, off-base referrals, visitor passes, vehicle registration, and finance. Temporary lodging at Hotel Frontera.
resources.address: Bldg 106 area, Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: 496th ABS Force Support Squadron
resources.description: Provides MWR, dining (El Comedor), fitness, recreation programs, events, and family support for Team Morón and transient forces.
resources.address: Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (MPF)
resources.description: Personnel actions, ID cards (RAPIDS appointments), DEERS, assignments, and in-processing support.
resources.address: Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: Recreation & Outdoor Activities
resources.description: FSS-supported programs including group fitness (Indoor Cycling, Total Body Reset, Glutes/Abs/Legs, Face to Face), sports (volleyball, basketball, softball, tennis, racquetball), and leisure events. Check calendar for seasonal activities.
resources.hours: Varies by program; see FSS events calendar
resources.address: Fitness & Sports Center / Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: Visitor Center / Pass & ID
resources.description: Base access passes, visitor registration, and vehicle processing. Located near Main Gate.
resources.address: Main Gate area, Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

resources.name: Security Forces / Base Defense
resources.description: 24/7 law enforcement, base defense, and security operations.
resources.address: Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

events.title: Newcomers Briefing
events.address: Morón AB, Morón de la Frontera, Spain
events.description: Orientation for incoming personnel and families. Bring orders and ID cards.

primaryAction.title: Morón AB Visitor Center / Pass & ID
primaryAction.address: Main Gate area, Morón Air Base, 41530 Morón de la Frontera, Spain

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Use the official newcomers page for Morón AB reporting instructions.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival for on-base waitlists and off-base referrals. Temporary lodging available through Hotel Frontera.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival and assist with base orientation. Contact your gaining unit if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource, Military.com, and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
